title: get: the reply
description: A delivery, taken from the queue; queued, to a get that waited, which takes none; the close, on a closed Accord with nothing queued; nothing; or a refusal.

delivery.description: The delivery, as the mediator returned it: its receipt and id, the message id, kind, salt, re, the body, and the answer call when an answer queued it.

queued.description: A delivery is queued for the caller; an ordinary get takes it.

close.description: The Accord's close receipt: a frozen format, carried as the door carries it.
